lyrics:
Jesus my Lord, my God, my all,
How can I love thee as I ought?
And how revere this wondrous gift,
So far surpassing hope or thought.
Sweet sacrament, we Thee adore,
0 make us love Thee more and more (2).

Had I but Mary's sinless heart,
To love Thee with, my dearest King.
Oh, with what bursts of fervent praise,
Thy goodness, Jesus, I would sing!
Sweet sacrament, we Thee adore,
0h make us love Thee more and more (2)

Jesus, dear Pastor of Thy flock,
We crowd in love about Thy feet,
Our voices yearn to praise Thee, Lord,
And joyfully Thy presence greet.
Sweet sacrament, we Thee adore,
0 make us love Thee more and more (2)
